title: Created a Space Trader game using AI
author: Revolutionary_Act878
selftext:
What started off as just harmless tinkering has turned into a two week obsession! I’ve always loved a certain space trading game from the 80s and wondered if I could use AI to create something similar that would run in a browser.  Well, it turns out you can! I don’t have any coding skills other than Excel Macros and obviously AI did the work here but I’m pretty pleased with it. Also learning Blender for ship design and even used AI to create a little  
app that converts the .glb ship file into a .js file that the AI can drop into the game.

comments.author: Shalke97
comments.body: I tried this once. I really Like that genre, but i did it in 2D, top down. Was one of my first AI Projects. After releasing my First Game in Steam i might start Something similar as a new Project. If you want someone to share dev stuff in discord let me know. I work as a programmer irl with Specialization moving towards AI.

comments.author: sevenoutdb
comments.body: very brave to take on 3D, I almost moved to 3D several times and chickened out. Will try again. I gotta admit, it looks a lot cleaner than my game. Well done. I'm hella jealous. I have to add some meaningful trading. TBD

replies.author: Revolutionary_Act878
replies.body:
Currently on version 231  
To be fair V1 was just the ship flying around the space environment and it worked well straight out of the box which surprised me, I’ve added features and refinements in controlled batches. Asking the AI to assess each enhancement or addition before making any changes.  
I test every version to tweak or adjust before moving to next feature set.
